'''Stormsurgeons''' were a variant of standard [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that were field [[Medic/Legends|medics]] who were responsible for providing emergency medical treatment at a point of wounding in a combat.

The [[Imperial medic/Legends|Imperial medical personnel]] were identified among standard [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] via their bronze-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]].<ref name="An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
